body.message:
Your listing caught my attention and I thought to reach out. I have managed 2 properties as a cohost and would love to manage more to improve my portfolio and skill.

My responsibilities include: 
• Responding to guest messages quickly and professionally
• Handling booking inquiries and reservation management
• Coordinating with cleaners and maintenance teams
• Managing check-in / check-out instructions
• Resolving guest issues or complaints
• Monitor calendars and pricing
• Ensure smooth daily operations across all listings
 
I am organized and able to manage multiple listings simultaneously.


If you need an assistant for your company or more hands to join your team, I’d be glad to assist.

Let me know if this sits well with you.

Best regards
Inyeneobong David.
